overview_description.description:
Wren is a web app that helps live carbon neutral by accounting for and offsetting CO2 emissions. It aims to build tools that help everyone act against climate change. Starting with a subscription service has the added advantage of funding their future work. They believe the most effective way we can build a team to tackle this problem is to build a sustainable business.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

product.name: Carbon Footprint Calculator
product.description: A tool to calculate individual or business CO2 emissions based on various activities and inputs.

product.description: A subscription service allowing individuals to offset their calculated carbon emissions monthly by funding climate projects.

identifier.value: Custom Carbon Offset Portfolios for Business

product.name: Custom Carbon Offset Portfolios for Business
product.description: A service for businesses to fund certified carbon removal projects and meet sustainability targets through tailored offset portfolios.

product.name: Wren API
